headline: A big gain for the Chiefs
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw the ball to T.Kelce for a 16-yard gain, which gives the Chiefs a fresh set of four tries to move down the field.
why_it_matters: This successful play is great news for the Chiefs and boosts their chances of winning the game by 6 percentage points. Moving the ball like this keeps their drive alive and puts them in a better position to score.
pop_culture: T.Kelce caught another pass and led the team with nine catches and 101 yards tonight.
